dedupe_keys.name: gis arso gov si earthquake hazard datasets

description: gis.arso.gov.si: earthquake hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.arso.gov.si. Coverage: the area served by gis.arso.gov.si. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about earthquake hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Karta potresne nevarnosti - WMS spletna storitev; Državna mreža potresnih opazovalnic - ATOM spletna storitev prenosa po; Državna mreža potresnih opazovalnic - WMS spletna storitev. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
